title: 第98章 卖货，卖货
content_zh:
第98章 卖货，卖货-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“卖鱼的怎么还没来，都啥时候了？”

“不会不来了吧？”

“怎么可能，那小子昨天还说了，今天早晨肯定会来的，不过今天人怎么这么多？”

“呦，这不是二大爷吗？你也来买鱼？”

“是啊，听说这里的鱼便宜，才九分钱一斤，还买十斤送一斤，这么便宜，在别的地方可寻不到啊！”

“是啊，快比地瓜便宜了！”

“地瓜那东西，吃多了放臭屁，哪里有炖鱼好吃，这一次我得多买些回去，放到家中晒成咸鱼干，想吃的时候拿出来炖了，那味道……啧啧啧……！”

“不过，都这么久了，咋回事嘛……！”

“再等等，再等等吧！”

土乡赶集的人一边一脸怨气，一边安慰自己，谁让这鱼肉这么便宜呢，确实是比地瓜都要便宜，不仅能够乱炖，还能煮鱼汤，有荤腥味，总归是要比地瓜好吃多了。

今天晚上乱炖的鱼，等到明天煮玉米面铁饼！！

啧啧啧，那味道，真是绝了。

至于什么不用白面铁饼，那不是贵吗，谁家吃得起啊，太败家了，日子还过不过的？

“来了来了，卖鱼的来了！”

就在这时。

一道高亢的声音，将人群炸醒，一个个瞪大了眼睛，目光齐刷刷朝着远处望去。

果然。

李青山一行人正推着板车朝着这边赶，这群土乡的来买鱼的大爷婶子们，疯狂的朝着李青山板车的方向冲了过去，一个个眼神中都放着精光。

“我勒个去，山哥，我怎么感觉有些不太对劲呢！”

“这是来干嘛的？买鱼吗？”

“这么多人啊？”

“山哥，咱们这点鱼，还够卖吗？”

大壮二壮和赵红旗，望着蜂拥的人群，整个人都麻了，昨天的客人还没有这么多呢。

昨天的人确实不多。

但是，等到昨天买鱼的客人回到家后一阵乱炖，鱼香的味道飘了出去，一个个在八卦和谈话之中知晓了这边的鱼买的便宜，也就地瓜的价格，不少人都心动了。

这不，一大早上！！

想要买鱼的客人，蜂拥而至。

没办法，便宜，还好吃啊！

“算了，直接在这里卖吧！”

望着周围已经冲过来的热情客人们，李青山开口道。

"Why hasn't the fish seller come yet? What time is it?"

"You won't come, will you?"

"How is it possible? That guy said yesterday that he would definitely come this morning, but why are there so many people today?"

"Hey, isn't this the second uncle? Are you here to buy fish too?"

"Yes, I heard that the fish here are cheap, only nine cents per catty, and they even buy ten catties and get one catty free. It's so cheap, you can't find it anywhere else!"

"Yeah, almost cheaper than sweet potatoes!"

"Sweet potatoes make you fart when you eat too much. There is no delicious fish stew anywhere. This time I have to buy some and put them at home to dry them into dried salted fish. When I want to eat them, I take them out and stew them. The taste... tsk tsk tsk tsk...!"

"But, it's been so long, what's going on...!"

"Wait a little longer, wait a little longer!"

The people who went to the Tuxiang market looked resentful and comforted themselves, who made this fish so cheap? It is indeed cheaper than sweet potatoes. Not only can it be stewed, but it can also be made into fish soup. It has a fishy smell, and it is much more delicious than sweet potatoes.

I stewed the fish tonight and cooked the cornmeal discus tomorrow!!

Tsk tsk tsk, that taste is really amazing.

As for why we don’t use white-faced discus, isn’t it expensive? Who can afford it? It’s so wasteful that we can’t survive?

"Come on, come on, the fish seller is here!"

Just then.

A high-pitched voice woke up the crowd. Everyone's eyes widened and they all looked into the distance.

really.

Li Qingshan and his group were pushing the cart this way. This group of uncles and aunts from the countryside who came to buy fish rushed towards Li Qingshan's cart like crazy, with their eyes shining brightly.

"Let me go, Brother Shan, why do I feel something is not right!"

"What are you here for? Buying fish?"

"So many people?"

"Brother Shan, do we still have enough fish to sell?"

Da Zhuang Er Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi looked at the swarming crowd and felt numb. There were not so many guests yesterday.

There weren't many people there yesterday.

However, when the customers who bought fish yesterday came home and stewed it for a while, the smell of fish wafted out. Through gossip and conversation, everyone learned that the fish here was cheap, the price of sweet potatoes, and many people were moved.

No, this is early in the morning!!

Customers who want to buy fish flock here.

No choice, it’s cheap, and it’s delicious!

"Forget it, just sell it here!"

Looking at the enthusiastic guests rushing over, Li Qingshan said.
